mapper.insert: insert into "h_survey" (username, service_rate1, service_rate2, cost_rate, equip_rate1, equip_rate2, employee_rate1, employee_rate2, injury_issue, injury_area) values (#{username}, #{serviceRate1}, #{serviceRate2}, #{costRate}, #{equipRate1}, #{equipRate2}, #{employeeRate1}, #{employeeRate2}, #{injuryIssue}, #{injuryArea})
mapper.select: select survey_id, username, service_rate1, service_rate2, cost_rate, equip_rate1, equip_rate2, employee_rate1, employee_rate2, injury_issue, injury_area from "h_survey" where username = #{username} order by survey_id desc limit 1

select s1.survey_id, s1.username, s1.service_rate1, s1.service_rate2, s1.cost_rate, s1.equip_rate1, s1.equip_rate2, s1.employee_rate1, s1.employee_rate2, s1.injury_issue, s1.injury_area from "h_survey" s1 join ( select username, max(survey_id) as max_survey_id from "h_survey" group by username ) latest on s1.username = latest.username and s1.survey_id = latest.max_survey_id
